db_adapter.description: Database adapter: 'postgresql', 'mysql2', or 'sqlite3'. Use 'sqlite3' for single-instance deployments.

db_host.description: Database server hostname or IP. Leave empty for SQLite.

db_username.description: Database user with access to the Redmine database.

db_password.description: Password for the database user (required for remote databases).

db_port.description: Port number for the database server (0 for default port).

db_socket.description: Unix socket path (used for local MySQL/PostgreSQL; omit if using TCP).

db_encoding.description: Database character encoding (e.g., 'utf8', 'utf8mb4'). Use 'utf8mb4' for full Unicode support.

db_reconnect.description: Automatically reconnect to MySQL on disconnect (MySQL only).

db_prepared_statements.description: Enable prepared statements for PostgreSQL or MySQL (improves security & performance).

secret_token.description: Random string (≥30 chars) used to encrypt sessions. Regenerate if compromised.

smtp_domain.description: Domain for SMTP HELO/EHLO (your server’s FQDN).

smtp_enable_starttls.description: Enable STARTTLS if the SMTP server supports it.

site_name.description: Public-facing name for your Redmine instance (e.g., 'Company Project Hub').

theme.description: Theme name (legacy; modern deployments use CSS overrides or plugins).

base_url.description: Full URL to your Redmine installation (used in emails and API links).

gravatar_enabled.description: Display Gravatar avatars for users without uploaded photos.

max_upload_size.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (0 for unlimited; default: 5 MB).

activity_enabled.description: Enable activity feeds on project pages.

activity_days_default.description: Default number of days shown in activity view.

timelogging_enabled.description: Enable time tracking (logging spent time on issues).

enabled_modules.description: List of modules enabled by default for new projects.
